PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-008.text: completeRegistration must verify user has member.members profile before card link.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-008.assertion: forall u: complete_registration(u, token) => exists(member.members WHERE id=u.id)

PROP-kintai-v3-st-post-004.text: On OAuth authentication failure, user session must be fully signed out before redirect.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-028.text: Previous incomplete temp_registrations must be deleted before creating new one for same card.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-028.assertion: forall card: before(insert_temp_reg(card)) => count(temp_reg WHERE card_id=card AND !used) == 0

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-029.text: force-logout-all time window must enforce JST 22:50-23:50 boundary strictly.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-031.text: Realtime subscription to temp_registrations must not leak registration data to unauthorized users.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-034.text: force-logout-all log entries must record caller identity for audit attribution.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-034.assertion: forall log: daily_logout_logs(log) => log.caller_id IS NOT NULL

PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-009.text: forceToggleAttendance must verify caller is admin before toggling another user's attendance.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-009.assertion: forall req: force_toggle(req, userId) => is_admin(req.caller) == true

PROP-e5782b58-pre-001.text: Force-logout-all endpoint must require authentication before executing bulk status update.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-001.assertion: forall req to /api/admin/force-logout-all: req.session.is_authenticated == true AND req.user.is_admin == true

PROP-e5782b58-pre-002.text: Force-logout-all must enforce time-gate restriction (22:50-23:50 JST) before execution.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-002.assertion: forall req to force-logout-all: current_time_jst >= 22:50 AND current_time_jst <= 23:50

PROP-e5782b58-pre-003.text: Card_id from NFC HID input must be validated/sanitized before database query to prevent injection.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-003.assertion: forall card_id from HID: card_id matches /^[A-Fa-f0-9]+$/ AND len(card_id) <= 32

PROP-e5782b58-inv-001.text: Attendance status must toggle between 'in' and 'out' on each punch; first punch is always 'in'.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-001.assertion: forall user u, day d: first_record(u,d).type == 'in' AND record[n].type != record[n-1].type

PROP-e5782b58-inv-002.text: Every attendance record must have server-side timestamp, never client-provided.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-002.assertion: forall attendance a: a.timestamp == server_now() at insertion time

PROP-e5782b58-pre-004.text: Record_attendance_by_card RPC must be atomic to prevent race conditions on concurrent punches.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-004.assertion: forall concurrent calls record_attendance(card_id): serializable isolation on (user_id, date) pair

PROP-e5782b58-inv-003.text: QR registration token must be cryptographically random and unique across temp_registrations.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-003.assertion: forall token t in temp_registrations: is_crypto_random(t.qr_token) AND unique(t.qr_token)

PROP-e5782b58-pre-005.text: Temp registration token must be rejected if expired (>30min) or already used (is_used=true).
PROP-e5782b58-pre-005.assertion: forall token access: reject if expires_at < now() OR is_used == true

PROP-e5782b58-inv-004.text: Temp registration is_used must be set to true atomically upon successful registration completion.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-004.assertion: forall completeRegistration(token): is_used = true set in same transaction as user insert

PROP-e5782b58-pre-006.text: Registration must verify Discord guild membership and generation role before creating user.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-006.assertion: forall completeRegistration(token, user): user.in_guild(target_guild) AND user.has_role(generation_role)

PROP-e5782b58-inv-005.text: Card_id must have UNIQUE constraint in attendance.users; each card maps to at most one user.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-005.assertion: forall card_id c in attendance.users: count(users WHERE card_id = c) <= 1

PROP-e5782b58-pre-007.text: Admin endpoints must verify is_admin=true at server side before allowing access to management functions.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-007.assertion: forall admin_action(user): user.is_admin == true checked server-side before execution

PROP-e5782b58-pre-008.text: Non-admin users must only access their own attendance records; IDOR on user_id must be prevented.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-008.assertion: forall query(user, target_user_id): user.is_admin == false => target_user_id == user.id

PROP-e5782b58-asm-001.text: RLS policies must enforce that non-admin users cannot read other users' member records.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-001.assertion: forall SELECT on members.users by user u: u.is_admin == false => row.id == u.id

PROP-e5782b58-asm-002.text: Attendance writes must be restricted to service_role only; anon/authenticated roles must not insert.

PROP-e5782b58-asm-003.text: Supabase admin client (service_role key) must never be exposed to client-side code.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-003.assertion: service_role_key not present in client bundles or browser-accessible code

PROP-e5782b58-inv-006.text: Only one announcement must have is_current=true at any time; set-current must atomically unset others.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-006.assertion: count(announcements WHERE is_current = true AND deleted_at IS NULL) <= 1

PROP-e5782b58-pre-009.text: Announcement CRUD operations must require admin authentication (is_admin=true).

PROP-e5782b58-inv-007.text: All admin user edits must be logged in user_edit_logs with timestamp and changed fields.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-007.assertion: forall admin_edit(user, fields): exists(user_edit_logs WHERE target_user = user AND timestamp = now())

PROP-e5782b58-pre-010.text: Discord OAuth callback must validate state parameter to prevent CSRF attacks.

PROP-e5782b58-pre-011.text: STEM OAuth PKCE flow must use code_verifier/code_challenge; authorization code must not be replayable.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-011.assertion: forall token_exchange(code, verifier): sha256(verifier) == stored_challenge AND code.is_single_use

PROP-e5782b58-inv-008.text: Registration must be atomic: members.users, attendance.users, and team relations all succeed or all fail.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-008.assertion: forall completeRegistration: (members.users + attendance.users + relations) in single transaction

PROP-e5782b58-pre-012.text: CreateTempRegistration must reject card_id if already registered in attendance.users.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-012.assertion: forall createTempRegistration(card_id): card_id NOT IN attendance.users.card_id

PROP-e5782b58-pre-013.text: CreateTempRegistration must reject if an active (non-expired) temp_registration exists for card_id.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-013.assertion: forall createTempRegistration(card_id): NOT EXISTS(temp_reg WHERE card_id AND expires_at > now() AND NOT is_used)

PROP-e5782b58-inv-009.text: Temp_registration expires_at must equal creation_time + 30 minutes exactly.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-009.assertion: forall temp_reg: temp_reg.expires_at == temp_reg.created_at + interval '30 minutes'

PROP-e5782b58-pre-014.text: Admin toggle-admin must not allow self-demotion that removes the last admin from the system.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-014.assertion: forall toggle_admin(admin, target): NOT (target == admin AND count(admins) == 1)

PROP-e5782b58-pre-015.text: Card_id change in admin user management must check uniqueness before updating.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-015.assertion: forall update_card(user, new_card_id): new_card_id NOT IN attendance.users.card_id

PROP-e5782b58-inv-011.text: Soft-deleted users (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) must be excluded from all active user queries.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-011.assertion: forall active_query on members.users: WHERE deleted_at IS NULL applied

PROP-e5782b58-asm-004.text: Kiosk endpoint /register/{token} must not leak other users' data in error responses.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-004.assertion: forall error_response from /register/{token}: response contains no PII, discord_id, or user records

PROP-e5782b58-asm-005.text: Server actions must not return Discord UIDs or PII of other users in responses to non-admin callers.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-005.assertion: forall server_action_response(user, data): user.is_admin == false => no other_user.discord_id in data

PROP-e5782b58-inv-012.text: Force-logout-all must set ALL users' status to 'out' and log execution with timestamp.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-012.assertion: forall force_logout_all: post(count(users WHERE status != 'out')) == 0 AND log_entry exists

PROP-e5782b58-inv-013.text: Permission_level must only be modifiable by admin users through admin user management endpoint.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-013.assertion: forall UPDATE members.users SET is_admin: caller.is_admin == true AND via admin endpoint only

PROP-e5782b58-asm-006.text: Supabase anon key client must enforce RLS; no RLS-bypassing queries via anon client.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-006.assertion: forall query via anon_client: RLS policies active AND enforced

PROP-e5782b58-pre-016.text: Kiosk middleware must restrict /kiosk routes to authorized access only (IP allowlist or secret).
PROP-e5782b58-pre-016.assertion: forall request to /kiosk/*: request passes kiosk access gate validation

PROP-e5782b58-inv-014.text: Discord_id must be unique across members.users; duplicate discord_id registration must be rejected.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-014.assertion: forall INSERT into members.users: UNIQUE(discord_id) constraint enforced

PROP-e5782b58-inv-015.text: Display_name must be unique across members.users to prevent impersonation.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-015.assertion: forall INSERT/UPDATE members.users: UNIQUE(display_name) constraint enforced

PROP-e5782b58-pre-017.text: QR token must have sufficient entropy (>=128 bits) to prevent brute-force guessing within 30min window.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-017.assertion: forall qr_token: entropy(qr_token) >= 128 bits AND generated via CSPRNG

PROP-e5782b58-pre-018.text: Rate limiting must exist on QR token access endpoint to prevent brute-force enumeration.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-018.assertion: forall /register/{token} requests from IP: rate_limit(IP) <= threshold per window

PROP-e5782b58-post-001.text: After force-logout-all, the daily_logout_logs table must contain an entry for the execution.
PROP-e5782b58-post-001.assertion: forall force_logout_all(): EXISTS(daily_logout_logs WHERE date = today AND timestamp = now())

PROP-e5782b58-inv-016.text: Members.users.id must reference auth.users(id) from Discord OAuth; no orphaned member records.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-016.assertion: forall m in members.users: EXISTS(auth.users WHERE id = m.id)

PROP-e5782b58-asm-007.text: Bearer token for STEM Bot API calls must not be logged or exposed in client responses.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-007.assertion: STEM_BOT_API_TOKEN not in logs, error messages, or client-visible responses

PROP-e5782b58-pre-019.text: Discord membership verification must be checked on every login, not cached from prior sessions.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-019.assertion: forall login(user): discord_guild_check(user.discord_id) called at auth time, not from cache

PROP-e5782b58-inv-017.text: Rapid consecutive NFC punches for same card_id must not create duplicate attendance records.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-017.assertion: forall rapid_punches(card_id, window<2s): only one attendance record created per toggle
